Docket 1.3.102

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *One problem in full.* The free result now shows the most important problem
  Docket found, with what it is, where it is and the fix, and says how many more
  problems it found. Buying opens the same audit with all of them. The command
  line prints the same.
- *Refresh checks what is overdue.* On the watchlist, Refresh used to say "Up to
  date" even when a site had not been checked for a week. It now starts the
  overdue checks, one after another, and says how many. An overdue row says
  "overdue", and a check that failed shows why on its row.

99 checks across 13 areas.
